situation:
You are the guest experience manager at BRIARFIELD AMPHITHEATER, an outdoor concert venue built on forty acres of former farmland outside a mid-sized city. The founder (judge) opened the amphitheater two years ago and is running the third season on what is left of the money raised at launch. The founder (judge) has asked you to recommend how guests should reach the venue next season and what the venue sells them once they arrive.

Briarfield sells an evening rather than a seat. Guests park on the meadow beside the stage, spread blankets on the grass, and order from a tailgate menu the kitchen rewrites each week around what the neighboring farms have picked. Regulars arrive three hours early to do it, and the tailgate menu is what reviewers name when they explain why the drive out of town is worth making.

The meadow is also the problem. Cars back up on the two-lane county road for nearly an hour before curtain, the county permit limits how many vehicles the meadow may hold, and food costs have risen sharply for two straight seasons. RIVERBEND TRANSIT has offered a park-and-ride contract under which guests would leave their cars at commuter lots downtown and ride shuttles in, clearing the road and costing the venue less per guest than staffing the meadow.

Signing the park-and-ride contract with RIVERBEND TRANSIT would end meadow parking, and it would end the tailgate menu that meadow parking makes possible. Keeping the meadow open and raising the season parking pass to cover the risen food costs would hold on to the tailgate menu, but the road stays backed up and the venue keeps turning away cars on the nights the county permit limit is reached.

The founder (judge) wants your reading of what actually brings a guest out to Briarfield, your recommendation on how guests should arrive next season, and your thinking on what the venue should offer them once they are on the grounds. When you enter the office, the founder (judge) will greet you and ask to hear your ideas. After your presentation and questions, the founder (judge) will thank you for your time.
